activities.name: Transfăgărășan road
activities.note: 90 km over the Făgăraș mountains, topping out at 2,042 m at Bâlea Lake. The lower sections stay open; it is the alpine crossing that is gated

windows.reason: open end to end from 1 July to 31 October, weather permitting
the opening date moves each year with the snow clearance and the avalanche risk — check before setting out
